Residue: Residues with a heavy atom within 4 A of the ligand in the structure of the human vitamin D-binding protein (GC) with 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 (PDB 1J78, chain B), numbered as in the PDB entry. Hydrogen bond: a protein N or O atom within 3.5 A of a ligand O atom. Residues of the other proteins are taken from the alignments of the phylogenetic analysis.
